deliverable_name: 首版关联规则与覆盖报告
join_unit: one canonical semantic ad identified by JOB_HASH + SOURCE_FILE + SOURCE_ROW + RECORD_SOURCE_ROW

records_join.required_cardinality: exactly 0 or 1 Records row per canonical semantic ad; report 0, 1, and >1 before analysis
records_join.company_interpretation: COMPANY_ID is a company-scrape entity identifier. It is not assumed to be a stable economic firm, ultimate parent, establishment, or employer entity across time.
records_join.base_hash_interpretation: BASE_HASH is a vendor multi-location grouping key, not a vacancy or hiring count.

onet_join.precondition: O*NET source has 356299258 unique JOB_HASH values with no duplicate keys or multi-code conflicts in the completed audit
onet_join.membership: Attach the official O*NET-SOC 2019 membership flag; retain missing key, blank code, 99-9999.00 placeholder, other nonmember, and official member as separate states.
onet_join.prohibition: Snapshot assignment is not contemporaneous occupation evidence or classification accuracy.

remote_policy.reason: Remote has multiple rows per JOB_HASH and concentrated 2024 starts; a direct join multiplies ads and lacks a frozen endpoint/as-of convention.
remote_policy.future_requirement: Preaggregate to one declared ad-level status with explicit interval convention and report zero/one/multiple input rows before any left join.

coverage_receipt: joined rows equal canonical semantic denominator

validity_separation.identity_and_coverage: Report join cardinality, denominator conservation, missingness and taxonomy-membership coverage as engineering facts.
validity_separation.text_time: JOB_HASH uniqueness and Records dates do not establish historical description versions. Until vendor/version evidence is verified, describe snapshot text by first-observation cohort only.
validity_separation.not_frozen: Historical panel validity remains unresolved and is not a condition silently inferred from successful joins.

privacy: Release only aggregate coverage and analysis cells; no URL, company name, raw title, raw text, row-level mapping, or credentials.
